_decision: 2026-10-31, chemistry lead (docs/chemistry-lead-memo-2026-10-31.md): 315-345 K (42-72 C), SOFT (+/-10 K). Upper: HBM accelerator max operating 80 C (353 K) minus >=8 K junction-to-PCM; lower: the PCM must refreeze against a ~40 C radiator. One 2026 orbital design targets ~40 C junctions, which would move it to ~295-310 K.
score: latent heat per kg in kJ/kg (primary; launch cost scales with mass). Trusted conductivity is reported in the note as the secondary criterion and breaks ties.
